Expanse node architecture

Expanse is operated by San Diego Supercomputer Center in United States. This profile covers Standard CPU and GPU partitions. Specifications are listed below; anything the operator has not published is itemised in the documented-fields list.

Scope and uncertainty

Standard CPU and GPU partitions only. Four large-memory nodes are excluded from this profile pending detailed verification.
